about: Held-out intent probe v2. Written on 2026-10-25 after the rule layer was rewritten and before it was run on these texts; scored once and not used for tuning. Mixes the six request languages, every non-deletion category from problem_statement.md, deletion requests with retention allowances, and prompt-injection attempts in both directions.
